labels: multiples of 3 both alpha/beta; remaining even alpha, odd beta
sparse_number: multiples of 16, alternating integer and double+0.5; removed at multiples of 16 during mutation
mixed: ordinal mod4: integer, text, NULL, missing
text: ordinal mod4 lengths 0,2,63,1024; embedded NUL at midpoint when length >=2
delete: multiples of 32; deletion precedes other mutation rules
old_pin: held across all mutations, full oracle checked again before release
oracle: all IDs, complete labels and all Property values plus count/sum queries; no latency samples
oracle_source_account_binding: same shared caller budget during snapshot creation and visits
